note: bare-shape classes (rect class=group/store/node, not <g>-wrapped) -> CLASS_PLACEMENT
bare-shape classes (rect/text class=node/group/store, not <g>-wrapped) -> CLASS_PLACEMENT; also fill="none" attrs -> PAINT_ATTR
embedded <style> block + hex color literals -> STYLE_BLOCK + COLOR_LITERAL; the four warnings are pre-existing TEXT_OVERFLOW near the right margin
embedded <style> block with CSS custom properties -> STYLE_BLOCK
<script>/<foreignObject>/<image> present -> BANNED_ELEMENT (ban-list line 155)
<g class="node store"> -> exactly one SHAPE_COMBO failure; the retired legacy combo
<rect class="proc"> -> CLASS_PLACEMENT; the 17 silhouettes belong on a <g>
a table nested inside an llm -> one NEST_PARENT failure and nothing else; an llm may not hold anything, so it is never also told to add "holds"
a proc nested inside a table -> NEST_PARENT; a table's interior is its own body cells, and a cell is the one child any silhouette may take
a proc nested inside a lane -> NEST_PARENT; a lane is a swimlane HEADER, a small box with a lifeline dropping below it, and the contract names it never-a-parent twice and gives it no content-well row
machine > store > table -> NEST_DEPTH; the limit is two levels of component nesting

four SHAPE_TEXT_FIT warnings, never a failure: an fn label wider than W-40, and — since the rule measures path-drawn silhouettes too — a store wider than W-40, a decision wider than W-60 and a cloud wider than W-60

left: an fn rect overhanging a pkg well on both sides -> NEST_WELL. middle: a proc holding a component without "holds" -> HOLDS_MISSING, and the parent is nestable so the advice is actionable. right: a type overhanging node's own well -> NEST_WELL. All warn-tier

two NEST_WELL warnings through a bare <g>: the first pkg wraps its own body rect, the second fn wraps its child rect. Geometry is collected through any <g> that names no silhouette, so a wrapper cannot switch NEST_WELL and SHAPE_TEXT_FIT off while every number still parses and nothing reports it

"holds" on a childless proc and on a childless unclassed <g> -> two HOLDS_EMPTY. The modifier restyles the label to a muted 12px band by class alone, so a <g> that names no silhouette gets the same silent visual regression

width="180px" (legal SVG), width="abc" (a typo) and font-size="NaN" (which parses as a float, then compares False against everything) -> three GEOM_UNPARSEABLE warnings; without the rule all three boxes report clean while the checks that read those numbers are switched off or silently defaulted

a proc and a store nested inside a "node holds" -> clean; node is a plain rounded rect with a real interior and its own content well, so the fallback silhouette is no less capable than the silhouettes it stands in for

two swimlane headers with lifelines dropping below them and each participant's boxes drawn as SIBLINGS on its lifeline -> clean; this is the markup a sequence diagram uses, and the shape a lane may never take is in fail-nest-parent-lane.svg

three boxes no rule may guess at -> clean: a node drawing only sparkle paths and no body rect (a rect-drawn silhouette without its rect is not measured), a child carrying <path d="Z"> with no moveto (which must contribute no point rather than the origin), and a group smaller than its own well insets (an inverted well is skipped, not reported against every child)
a cell stack inside a type and inside a queue -> clean; Q11 makes a type's fields and a queue's items cells, and a cell is data rather than a component, so it is legal inside any silhouette

an iface and a machine whose labels fill their contract width exactly -> no SHAPE_TEXT_FIT; pins that the width table is measured against the box W, not the narrower body rect those two draw (subtracting both would warn on a correctly sized box)
clean contract-conforming fragment from this spec's own doc

clean contract-conforming fragment from this spec's own doc; its two former "node store" boxes are now "file" documents. The one warning is a pre-existing TEXT_OVERFLOW on an edgeLabel near the right margin, unrelated to the shape kit

all 17 new silhouettes, each correctly classed on its own <g>, plus spark on <path>. The cloud is the contract's own recipe, whose three arc endpoints walk x from X to X+W, so its measured width is exactly W and its W-60 row is really checked

the five legal containments (store>table, machine>proc+store, pkg>fn, proc>iface, ui>cell), every parent carrying "holds" and every child — including the iface lollipop knob, which is a <circle> outside its rect — inside the parent's well

combos that must NOT trip SHAPE_COMBO: cell head, node accent, bar ok, region warn, store holds, edge dashed ok, a spark path inside an agent, and ui > table > cell. Both "holds" parents really do hold something, so neither draws HOLDS_EMPTY
